label: Numbers
description: Numbers: add, subtract, multiply, divide, floor, round. IEEE 754 doubles, as JavaScript computes them; whole numbers are exact up to 2^53. A result that is not a finite number breaks the node, and the fault names the operation, never an operand.

subtract.description: a - b. To compare two computed numbers, subtract one from the other and compare the difference with 0.

multiply.description: a × b; fails where the result overflows to Infinity.

divide.description: a / b; fails where b is 0 (guard with a switch on b != 0 that routes here) or the result overflows.

floor.description: The largest whole number not above a: floor(-2.5) is -3.

round.description: a rounded to digits decimals, half away from zero: sign(a) × r / 10^digits, where r is the whole number nearest to |a| × 10^digits in doubles, the larger where two are equally near. round(2.5) is 3, round(-2.5) is -3, round(1.005, 2) is 1 since 1.005 × 100 is 100.49999999999999. -0 is answered as 0.

digits.description: a whole number from 0 to 15; 0 when absent
